About us

A trading business built on trust and precision

Under the leadership of proprietor and Managing Director Ashish Khatri, AK Exim and Trade Concern is a Kathmandu-based trading firm that imports and distributes everyday consumer goods.

We specialise in sourcing and supplying products that match what the Nepali market needs, and we operate openly as a firm registered with the Government of Nepal.
